analysis.visual_description: A fair leaf on the board, candlelight, the red thread lying ready and not yet knotted.
On the board. The same leaf, lower. The hand is not in the frame. A cross sits in the margin where a speech still wants the actors, and the word finished is not written.
On the board. The cross, and no other word beside it. The leaf is fair. The mark is a rehearsal mark.
On the board. The private-verse folder pushed to the far edge of the board. The fair leaves are squared on the near side. Nothing crosses the gap.
